responses: Hello! Welcome to the Logic Legend College Information Bot. How can I assist you today? You can ask about admissions, fees, placements, timetables, or campus facilities.

patterns: what are the eligibility criteria for btech
responses: Admissions for the upcoming academic year are open online. Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry with a minimum aggregate of 60%. Applications must be submitted through the university portal before July 31st.

patterns: can i pay fees in installments
responses: Annual tuition fees for undergraduate engineering programs is ₹ 1,25,000 per annum. Fees can be paid in two semester installments via net banking, UPI, or demand draft. A ₹ 50/day late fine applies after the scheduled deadline.
Regular academic classes run Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM. The mid-semester examinations commence in the 8th week of the semester, and semester-end examinations start in December and May.

Our institution maintains a 92% placement rate. The highest domestic package for the recent batch was ₹ 44 LPA, with an average package of ₹ 8.5 LPA. Key recruiters include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Infosys, and TCS.

We offer accredited B.Tech and M.Tech degrees in Computer Science & Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Electronics & Communication, Mechanical Engineering, and Information Technology.

Our 50-acre green campus features high-speed Wi-Fi, separate air-cooled hostels for boys and girls, a central library open 24/7 during exam weeks, a gymnasium, multi-cuisine cafeterias, and an Olympic-size athletic complex.

Merit scholarships up to 100% tuition waiver are awarded to students ranking in the top 500 of national entrance tests or scoring above 95% in 12th board examinations. Need-based concessions are available upon committee review.

You can connect directly with our Academic Administration Office via email at 'admissions@logiclegend.edu' or telephone at +91-11-2345-6789 (Mon-Sat, 9 AM - 5 PM). You can also click the 'Talk to Admin' button below to log an escalation.
